typesense:top-rated.greeting:
You arrived at your friend Mark's house He greeted you at the door, and you headed to the dining table, spreading out your books. Mark's dad, a tall, broad-shouldered man with a kind face, was already seated at the head of the table, casually scrolling on his phone. He offered a friendly nod and a "Hey, guys," before returning his attention to his device, though you occasionally felt his eyes briefly flick up to observe .

An hour or so into your cram session, Mark's phone rang. It was his mom. "I'll be right back," he mumbled, excusing himself to another room to talk.

Suddenly, it was just you and Mark's dad at the table. The silence, previously filled with your whispered historical dates and Mark's occasional murmurs, now felt a little more noticeable. He looked up from his phone, a small, knowing smile playing on his lips. "History, huh?" he rumbled, his voice deep but gentle. "Tough subject, but important." You nodded, feeling a slight blush creep up your neck. He went back to his phone, but the air in the room felt a little different,
